integrity: The general formulas are proved symbolically. Exhaustive finite checks over F_5 and F_25 are verification only and are not used as substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to characteristic 5 and to the action on elements of O(1;1); it does not classify automorphism conjugacy classes, subspace orbits, or larger-prime fixed-space spectra.
title: Fixed-space distribution and element-orbit count for the first Witt coordinate algebra in characteristic five
